title: Calculus for ML: Derivatives and Gradients
description: Just enough calculus to actually understand how a model learns.
learningOutcomes: Explain a derivative as a rate of change, with intuition not just notation
Compute gradients for simple multivariable functions
Explain the chain rule as it applies to backpropagation

lessons.title: Derivatives as Rate of Change
lessons.description: The slope of a function, and why a model cares about it.
learningObjectives: Connect a derivative to 'which way to adjust a weight'

lessons.title: Partial Derivatives and Gradients
lessons.description: Derivatives when a function has many inputs, like a model's weights.
learningObjectives: Assemble partial derivatives into a gradient vector
Explain the gradient as the direction of steepest increase

lessons.title: The Chain Rule
lessons.description: The one calculus rule that makes backpropagation possible.
learningObjectives: Apply the chain rule to a composed function
Explain backpropagation as repeated chain rule
Trace a gradient through two chained operations

lessons.title: Gradient Descent: the Math Behind Training
lessons.description: Why 'follow the negative gradient' is the entire training algorithm.
learningObjectives: Explain why training subtracts the gradient
Explain the learning rate's role geometrically
Connect this lesson directly to a PyTorch training loop
